fact: Car 43 allegedly caused a collision with Car 55 at turn 8.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, team radio and in-car video evidence. The Stewards concluded that the collision with Car 55 was caused by the unexpected change of direction of Car 55. Car 55 allowed other cars to pass following its prior collision with Car 27, which caused damage to Car 55. Car 55 then attempted to move to the right off the racing line and was collided with by Car 43.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 43 Allegedly Causing A Collision With Car 55
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine F1 Team
